premises.text: The makeup industry monetizes color scarcity: mass retail assortments are volume-constrained while prestige niche colors carry a large premium
premises.evidence_span: they do this by charging a huge premium on one thing that technology provides for free. And that one thing is color

premises.text: A proprietary desktop printer works like an inkjet to print wearable cosmetics from any phone, laptop, or camera image
premises.evidence_span: It's a proprietary piece of hardware. And it works just like an inkjet printer

premises.text: Users only need a hex color picker and ordinary print software with FDA-compliant ink and substrates from trusted-brand sources
premises.evidence_span: both of which are FDA compliant and come from the same exact sources as those of trusted brands

premises.text: About $300 hardware plus commodity-priced consumables delivers prestige-like selection with mass/home convenience
premises.evidence_span: I'm going to retail this for about $300 initially. And the ink and the substrates are going to be commodity priced. So they are very accessible

premises.text: Initial customers are girls 13–21 who already learn makeup online and have not yet formed brand habits
premises.evidence_span: this is how they already know, learn how to put on makeup. This is their natural habitat

value.text: Any digital color becomes printable home makeup, making the web an endless beauty aisle
value.evidence_span: The Mink enables the web to become the biggest beauty store in the world

secondary_value.text: Training girls that beauty definitions should be user-controlled rather than corporate-controlled
secondary_value.evidence_span: beauty is something that they should be able to control, not our corporations

causal_links.evidence_span: that's what the Mink does. It gives you the selection of prestige and it combines it with the convenience of mass
charging a huge premium on one thing that technology provides for free
instantly transform it into a wearable color cosmetic
I'm beating the convenience of mass because I'm giving you the convenience of your own freaking house
